findings.summary: Early bank drain empties the life bank in the first ~33 s: three missile deaths (each popping 'Touché par un missile…', survival.js:363) each spend one bank life for a checkpoint continue (checkpointContinue at survival.js:206-212, spend gate :211-212), so the blind keyboard driver reaches 282 m / 900 m with ♥ ×0 and the next death hard-fails on the 'TRY AGAIN' overlay ('… m parcourus', survival.js:235) — blind-driver missile deaths are expected difficulty (lethal radius 58 px vs drawn ring 64 px edge-forgiveness at :54-55, fall speed 380 px/s tuned so trajectories read at :56; the driver has no impact lookahead), so the actionable item is the early bank drain — no continues survive the first wave; no evidence dir persisted for this level, observations are from the rig trace.

Edge-coverage gap: the driver's edge phase (pause @~70 %, blur @~82 %, mash @90 % of the 240 s budget, playtest.py:165-176) never ran because the run ended early on the hard fail once the bank drained (~33 s in), leaving pause/blur/mash behavior unexercised for this level in this run.
